products.name: Tempus AI
products.note: Precision medicine AI; genomic data; clinical trial matching; genetic privacy (GINA)

reading.body:
Tempus holds 33 granted patents, with five issued between July 21 and September 8, 2026, concentrated in AI for cardiology, pathology, and genomics.

The recent patents cover translating 12-lead ECG algorithms to portable devices, detecting low ejection fraction from ECG data, resolving discordant HER2 status in pathology images, and normalizing RNA expression data. That pattern is application-layer AI for clinical diagnostics, not model training or infrastructure. The company's SEC filings show quarterly reports and multiple current reports through July 30, 2026, but the data does not include what those filings disclose.

For AI scaling, this record offers no evidence about compute demand, data center footprint, or power consumption. Tempus appears in the data as a healthcare AI product company, and any connection to grid constraints would have to come from sources not present here.
